source_facts.architecture: ColBERT late-interaction scoring on EmbeddingGemma-300M backbone
source_facts.repo_layout: root contains encoder/, tokenizer/, proj.pt, and inference.py; root does not contain config.json.
source_facts.projection_head: proj.pt must be applied after encoder hidden states before L2 normalization and MaxSim scoring.
source_facts.intended_runtime: vLLM pooling runner with token_embed pooler and /v1/score, /v1/rerank, and /pooling endpoints.

dtype_policy.reason: EmbeddingGemma backbone requires avoiding float16 activations. float32 is default for reference parity, reproducibility, and debuggability. bfloat16 may be used for throughput/memory-constrained deployments with ranking parity validation.
dtype_policy.dtype_change_note: Changing dtype may affect scores at the last decimal places. Validate ranking parity before switching to bfloat16 in production.

project_runtime_policy.promotion_gate: reference adapter ranking parity with vLLM native output
project_runtime_policy.policy_reason: ColBERT-Ko late-interaction retrieval on EmbeddingGemma-300M backbone; production uses prepared vLLM artifact so proj.pt is applied.
project_runtime_policy.vllm_args_notes: --pooler-config.task token_embed is required; --model-impl transformers must NOT be used; --dtype must be set explicitly.

top_n.description: rerank endpoint에서만 지원. score endpoint에서는 422를 반환한다.

truncate_prompt_tokens.description: 표준 파라미터. truncate_to_tokens는 deprecated alias이고 최대 192로 제한된다.

fixed_parameters.description: 사용자 요청에서 변경 불가. runtime 고정값이다.

batch_invariance.method: positions 기반 1D flattened input boundary 복원
batch_invariance.note: max_num_seqs=1은 임시 안전 기본값일 수 있으나 boundary 복원의 대체물이 아니다. boundary 복원이 없으면 batch size와 scheduler packing 상태에 따라 token embedding과 MaxSim score가 달라진다.
